claims.text: Salicylate toxicity (typically resp alkalosis + metabolic acidosis): rapid GI decontamination w activated charcoal, and alkalinization of serum and urine w IV bicarbonate.
claims.quote: Salicylate toxicity, which typically presents with a combination of respiratory alkalosis and metabolic acidosis, requires rapid gastrointestinal decontamination with activated charcoal and alkalinization of the serum and urine using intravenous bicarbonate.
